title: Global Regular Solutions for One-Dimensional Degenerate Compressible Non-Resistive MHD Equations with Large Data and Far-Field Vacuum
summary: We consider the Cauchy problem on the real line for a one-dimensional transverse-field isentropic non-resistive magnetohydrodynamic system with viscosity $μ(ρ)=αρ^δ$, $0 \tfrac32$. As a result, we extend the work of Cao, Li, and Zhu (SIAM J. Math. Anal., 2022) from the Navier-Stokes equations to the MHD equations.
